asset-name.text: The asset name is exactly the 32-byte hash of the spelling bytes. The entity diagram shows spelling to digest to live NFT under the scoping policy. Alice and its newline variant are pinned.

policy-parameters.text: The representative policy takes the application hash and the registry asset identity. The application validator itself takes no parameters.

registry-binding.text: Mint and burn enforce the exact registry credential and token. Maintenance and recovery preserve the token; completion spends the registry state; retirement goes through a withdrawal witness.

lifecycle-values.text: Permanent Over and incarnation zero. Over was minted then burned; unclaimed was never minted. The abstract model keeps naming scope zero.
